purpose: Synthetic, redistributable clips for comparing Faithful 10-bit and the optional libplacebo backend.
hardware_gate: Run on the target M3 macOS installation; the development sandbox cannot validate Metal/Vulkan.
required_checks: engine availability and Vulkan device creation
yuv420p10le output, unchanged dimensions and duration
audio stream count, metadata, chapters and supported subtitles
frame wipe at 200-400 percent for steps, softness, halos and chroma bleed
median and 1-percent-low FPS, memory pressure and thermal behavior
cancellation, collision, full-disk and relaunch behavior
